interface.title: kana v3.2.0: Single cell analysis in the browser
interface.stage_of_work: primary analysis and exploratory interpretation of a count matrix: QC, normalization, dimensionality reduction, clustering, marker genes
interface.what_it_is_for: Runs a standard OSCA-style single-cell pipeline in WebAssembly inside the browser on an uploaded count matrix, then lets you explore the embedding, clusters and marker genes and export the results.

data.note: I uploaded matrix.mtx and features.tsv on the '10X MatrixMarket' tab. In the first two runs I also uploaded barcodes.tsv; the final run used only the matrix and features. The dataset is tiny: 15 cells × 20 genes with Ensembl human IDs (screens/006.webp). With default QC (3 MADs), 12 of the 15 cells were removed (header '15 cells (3 after QC)', screens/022.webp). In the final run cell filtering was off, all 15 cells were kept, and they formed a single cluster (screens/033.webp). Several steps download reference assets from GitHub through cors-proxy.aaron-lun.workers.dev, and those downloads fail here: the default mitochondrial gene list (screens/015.webp), the cell-type references, and the gene-set collections (screens/025.webp). The gene-set download cannot be turned off, so every run ended with a 'RUN ERROR: Failed to fetch' dialog that cannot be closed (screens/033.webp). The results underneath were complete except for gene sets, and I worked them from the keyboard. ARTIFACT OF THIS ENVIRONMENT: the failed downloads, the RUN ERROR dialog and the missing gene sets come from running without outbound network access; they are not how the tool behaves on a connected machine.

not_done: Analysis never finished without error: feature_set_enrichment always tries to fetch 9606_ensembl.tsv.gz from GitHub through cors-proxy.aaron-lun.workers.dev, and there is no setting to skip it. The failure opens a RUN ERROR dialog that Escape does not close (screens/033.webp). After that I could use the results only through keyboard focus and dropdown selection by ref; I could not click on the canvas. This is an artifact of the offline environment, not normal tool behaviour.
Gene-set enrichment for each cluster (Gene sets tab): never produced, because the gene-set collections could not be downloaded offline.
Custom cell selection and its markers: this needs a drag on the embedding canvas in Selection mode, and the error dialog blocks mouse input, so I could not do it.
Annotating clusters with cell types from a reference: the reference datasets cannot be downloaded offline, so I disabled them.
Export as a .kana file: the v3.2.0 SAVE menu offers only parameters (browser or download) and a results ZIP. I started the results ZIP download; no kept screen shows the file or its contents.
Saving and restoring an analysis: 'Save analysis parameters (to browser)', 'Download analysis parameters', LOAD and 'explore existing analysis results' were not tried.
Comparing several clusters: every run gave only one cluster, because the test file has just 15 cells and 20 genes.
Recolouring the map by QC::RNA_sums: the selection was sent, but screens/026.webp still shows CLUSTERS and an empty map, so the result is not shown.

The droplet button (colour embedding by gene), Animate, Save as SVG, Click to filter markers and gene search were not confirmed. The droplet press gave no visible change, and the rest were not tried within the ~100-action budget.

Rerunning from the results view with a QC-metric annotation selected crashed the app with a React runtime error ('NaN is not a number' in DimPlot), leaving a blank page (screens/029.webp, screens/030.webp), so I had to restart from scratch.
